newsitem.title: JAMAICA: CRICKET-GANGULY AND MONGIA RESCUE INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GANGULY AND MONGIA RESCUE INDIA.

text.p: Saurav Ganguly and Nayan Mongia rescued India after a collapse against debutant paceman Franklyn Rose in the first test against West Indies at Sabina Park on Saturday.
Ganguly and Mongia batted through the afternoon session on the third day to take India from 155 for five to 234 for five at tea in reply to West Indies first innings of 427.

Ganguly, dropped by wicketkeeper Junior Murray off Rose just before lunch, was unbeaten on 42 and Mongia was 43 not out at tea, the pair having batted with increasing confidence to avert any threat of a follow-on.
The closest West Indies came to a wicket were two mix-ups between the batsmen which nearly resulted in Mongia being stranded.
West Indies had taken the upper hand in the first session when Rose captured four wickets after India resumed at the overnight 108 for one.
Rose dispatched Vangipurappu Laxman (64), Rahul Dravid (43), captain Sachin Tendulkar (7) and Mohammad Azharuddin (5) in a devastating seven-over spell.
